summary: Settings-layer exception hierarchy: StorageAuthError base, with 16 subclasses covering config, connection, validation, security, permission, encryption, timeout, quota, retry, pool, operation, version, state, feature, compatibility, and migration errors. All include contextual metadata in messages.
risks: 17 exception classes seems overspecified for current usage — many may be unused

open_questions.question: Which of these 17 exceptions are actually raised in practice?
open_questions.evidence: Large hierarchy without obvious test coverage for each
